page.content:
Interpol officer who hunts Shadaloo for her father's death.

How Chun-Li connects

  • Faction: World Warriors — Chun-Li is the Interpol World Warrior hunting Shadaloo.
  • Faction: Shadaloo — Chun-Li hunts Shadaloo for her father's death.
  • Character: Juri Han — Juri's sadism is aimed at Chun-Li across later games.

What is Chun-Li?

Chun-Li is the World Warrior from China whose Spinning Bird Kick and Interpol badge are aimed at M. Bison and Shadaloo, the organization she blames for her father.

Key threads lead to World Warriors, Shadaloo and Juri Han.
